Nia Lopez: Quick idea 1: run a 40m 'After-Hours Office Hour' for customers in APAC/EMEA who can't join daytime sessions. Lean agenda: 10m onboarding checklist, 15m live troubleshooting, 10m migration Q&A, 5m feedback. Thoughts?
Evan Moore: Love it. Suggest two weekly repeats: Tue 18:00 PT (works for APAC late) and Fri 08:30 GMT (EMEA friendly). Keep attendee cap to 12.
Jules Park: I can host Tue evenings. Will prepare a 1-page pre-read and a tiny sample config pastebin.
Nia Lopez: @Jules can you own the pre-read? Evan can own the Fri slot. I'll make the calendar template + registration form.
Jules Park: Will include a 3-question poll at the end: "Was this useful?", "Need CSM follow-up?", "Migration timeline?" Map 'Need CSM follow-up' -> create CSM task.
CS-AutoBot: Use webhook 'enablement->csm' to auto-create tasks. Tag tasks with #office-hour-followup.
Evan Moore: CalendarBot, reserve Zoom and set recording+transcript.
CalendarBot: Zoom link reserved: https://zoom.redwood.com/meet/1765432101. Recording and transcript enabled. Invites queued.
Nia Lopez: I'll schedule a 20m dry-run 24h before first event. Please react with :ok_hand: when you re set.
Jules Park: :ok_hand:
Evan Moore: :ok_hand:
CS-AutoBot: Post-session checklist will export slides, upload recording, and push flagged follow-ups to CSM queue.
